## Où j'en suis
The Fernhill ACS endpoint is done: signature verification and the SAML condition checks (conditions, audience, subject confirmation, replay protection in Redis, 120 s skew) were written with signxml after python3-saml proved unworkable on the Alpine image, `saml_utils` was moved to `api/auth/saml/verify.py`, and PR #412 is merged. The remaining work is operational: Fernhill's staging IdP metadata must be loaded and Kestrel's staging SP metadata sent to them before the Thursday 10:00 New York demo, and the SSO-enforcement topic needs its own ticket.

- [prochaine-étape] Load Fernhill's staging IdP metadata and send them our staging SP metadata by Wednesday end of day.
- [prochaine-étape] Open the separate ticket for enforcing SSO / disabling password login for Fernhill users.
- [essai-raté] python3-saml on the Alpine base: lxml/xmlsec libxml2 version mismatch, and building lxml from source only shifted the failure to xmlsec not finding its crypto library.
- [décision] Go with signxml, drop python3-saml and xmlsec entirely, write the condition checks with tests, and read attributes only from signed_xml (source: t08)
- [décision] Set the clock skew to 2 minutes per the Fernhill contract annex, and leave password login out of this PR (source: t12)
- [décision] No --admin and no --auto for the merge (source: t21)
